name: Swift Hewfall
description: Draw the bit back behind the hip and cleave forward with the whole body behind the stroke.

name: Brutal Haftrope
description: Push down hard with the upper hand on the haft to add weight to the falling edge.

name: Stubborn Greatbit
description: End a cleave with the haft braced across the body so the stroke also serves as a guard.

name: Timberlinen
description: Judge the exact reach of a cleave against the opponent's position before stepping into range.

name: Grim Haftbell
description: Cleave along the lines of the target's guard and armor so qi carries the bit between plates.

name: Wideswell Thwack
description: Land two cleaves in one breath with qi pushing the second stroke before the first has finished ringing.

name: Bold Poleshoe
description: Lean the whole body forward over the lead foot and let the head's weight pull the cut down.

name: Keen Splitmass
description: Drop the leading shoulder suddenly so the bit swings through a steeper and faster arc.

name: Swift Greatbeard
description: Let the momentum of one swing carry through into the next without stopping the head.

name: Springing Greatpoll
description: Take a short gathering step to build weight in the swing before the cut is released.

name: Timberprop
description: Pull the head back sharply to stop its momentum and cover the body with the shaft.

name: Attentive Doubleedge
description: Feel the mass of the swinging head through the haft to time when its weight peaks.

name: Dire Sunder
description: Keep the head circling and let qi feed each pass so the cleaves chain without a pause.

name: Timberbarrier
description: Meet an incoming blow with the swinging head and steer its force aside using a pulse of qi.

name: Fierce Overhew
description: Turn the whole body in one full circle and sweep the bit across the opponent's middle.

name: Brutal Heavyeye
description: Spin against the direction of the last swing and hew from the unexpected side.

name: Greatprop
description: Spin the haft in a circle before the body to turn aside thrusts from the front.

name: Greatswerve
description: Spin on the lead foot and step out of an attack while the head completes the turn.

name: Attentive Poleshoe
description: Count the opponent's guard changes and pick the moment when a full turn will pass unanswered.

name: Acrid Riven
description: Spin continuously while qi keeps the great bit sweeping a wide circle around the body.

name: Levering Greatbit
description: End a turn by hooking the beard behind the opponent's guard and pulling them off balance with qi.

name: Honed Haftbell
description: Chop at the top rim of the opponent's shield to knock it out of position.

name: Ember Longhelve
description: Hew along the joints between the boards of a shield where the wood is weakest.

name: Gripping Longhelve
description: Strike the central boss of a shield with the flat of the bit and shove it aside.

name: Clay Riven
description: Step to the open side of a shield wall where its owner cannot turn the cover in time.

name: Greatpoll Prop
description: Cross the haft over the forearms to stop a shield-bash driven into the chest.

name: Recall Wideswell
description: Read the tilt of the shield's edge to see which way its owner will thrust or turn.

name: Shard Rend
description: Bring the bit overhead with qi concentrated at the edge to split the shield from rim to boss.

name: Gall Greatbeard
description: Hook the beard over the shield rim and drag it down to expose the head of its holder.

name: Moment Haftrope
description: Hammer the shield with heavy repeated blows so its holder cannot lower it to attack.

name: Statictimber
description: Catch the opponent's weapon haft with the beard of the bit and pull it toward the body.

name: Lassoing Hewfall
description: Slip the beard beneath a raised arm or shield and lift to open the opponent's guard.

name: Timberscorer
description: Jab the toe tip of the bit short and fast into the gap in the opponent's guard.

name: Rillriven
description: Step inside the opponent's reach right after the beard has caught their weapon.

name: Clay Doubleedge
description: Let the hooked weapon go and swing the freed bit into the opponent's exposed side.

name: Rill Greatpoll
description: Hook the beard around an incoming blade and turn it off the body with a twist of the wrists.

name: Poleshoe Bandage
description: Feel the opponent's grip tension through the caught weapon to know when it will slip.

name: Binding Overhew
description: Wrench a hooked weapon sideways with a pulse of qi in the beard and tear it from the hand.

name: Gall Wideswell
description: Hook the beard behind an opponent's knee and pull with qi until they fall.

name: Sunder Slap
description: Pull the opponent forward with the beard and chop the instant their head comes within reach.

name: Doughty Rend
description: Chop at the same spot of a wooden post until the grain splits and the wood gives.

name: Rude Doubleedge
description: Drive the head into the middle of a door bar to snap it at its weakest point.

name: Sunderglide
description: Plant the haft on broken ground and step over fallen beams and splintered planks.

name: Rallying Greatbeard
description: Read where a frame is nailed or pegged to find the joint that will break first.

name: Sunderflog
description: Cleave through the iron hinge of a door with qi packed at the very edge of the bit.

name: Brutal Splitmass
description: Hew into a stacked barricade with qi-driven strokes until a gap opens wide enough for a man.

name: Brisk Sunder
description: Drag the bit low across the front and pull it toward the body as it cuts.

name: Axebarrier
description: Hook the beard behind a foe's ankle during the reap and pull it out from under them.

name: Gritrend
description: Step low behind the dragging bit so the body stays below the opponent's counter.

name: Lurching Heavyeye
description: Swing the bit back along the same line to cut again as the reap comes home.

name: Regimen Haftrope
description: Stand with the head lowered and ready so the haft covers the shins and thighs.

name: Greatlinen
description: Time the reap to the moment an opponent's front foot is lifting off the ground.

name: Cinder Longhelve
description: Sweep the bit through a wide low arc so qi cuts several foes standing in a line.

name: Brawntimber
description: Chain dragging reaps one after another with qi pulling the head back for each fresh pass.

name: Keen Greatbit
description: Grip both hands near the head and chop short inside the opponent's reach.

name: Rilltimber
description: Raise the flat cheek of the head to check a blow aimed at the face or neck.

name: Clay Heavyeye
description: Drive an elbow forward along the haft into the opponent's jaw as the shaft rises.

name: Clayrend
description: Step in and barge with the shoulder behind the haft to throw the opponent off balance.

name: Sure Greatbeard
description: Keep the haft touching the opponent's weapon to feel which way they are about to push.

name: Discord Rend
description: Lock the opponent's arm between haft and head and wrench with qi until the grip opens.

name: Brassaxe
description: Reverse the head and crack the flat poll against a helm with qi packed behind it.

name: Brasssunder
description: Begin a cleave by rolling the head over the lead shoulder to build its speed.

name: Staticaxe
description: Roll the head underneath the arms and cut upward at a low line from below.

name: Brawn Overhew
description: Roll the shoulders out of line and step away as the head wheels past the body.

name: Haze Doubleedge
description: Roll the haft over the forearms to turn aside strikes from above.

name: Knitting Heavyeye
description: Read the rhythm of the opponent's guard to choose the instant the next roll will begin.

name: Embersunder
description: Roll the head back across the wrists and chop again before the opponent can recover.

name: Riventhwack
description: Wheel the head through a rolling sequence of cleaves with qi sustaining the swing between cuts.

name: Gagging Longhelve
description: Roll the haft along the ground between an opponent's feet and trip them with a pulse of qi.

name: Crimson Riven
description: Pair a high rolling cleave with a low reaping return so the guard cannot cover both heights.

name: Crimson Splitmass
description: Release the grip tension at the top of the lift and let the whole head fall.

name: Sunderswat
description: Swing the head straight down with arms loose so gravity does most of the cutting.

name: Sprig Greatbit
description: Lift the haft overhead to catch a blow from above and take its weight on both arms.

name: Sunder Stalk
description: Drop the body's weight into a forward step so it lands together with the falling head.

name: Gap Haftbell
description: Read the line along which the opponent's own weapon is about to fall and move off it.

name: Stern Haftrope
description: Bring the flat of the head down like a hammer to stun without cutting.

name: Crimson Hewfall
description: Drop the head with qi concentrated in its mass so the cleave lands with crushing weight.

name: Momentriven
description: Rest the heavy head on the opponent's blocking weapon and press down with qi to pin it.
